# Slider

A value in a range, with the value shown in text.

- Status: implemented
- Category: input
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “slider”; HTML `<input type="range">`
- Text style: `label` (`.nd-text-label`)

## Anatomy

- **track**: The range.
- **fill**: From the start to the value.
- **thumb**: The target, at least the minimum size.
- **value**: The value in text.

## Variants

- `continuous`: Any value.
- `stepped`: Steps.

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `active`
- `focus-visible`
- `disabled`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Arrow keys | Step. |
| Home, End | Minimum, maximum. |
| Page Up, Page Down | Large steps. |

## Accessibility

- Role: slider
- Name: Its label; aria-valuetext when the number needs words.
- The native track accepts a click/tap without dragging (2.5.7). Keyboard support alone is not a single-pointer alternative.
- The input retains native keyboard, touch and accessibility behavior; show its current value in text.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA)
- 2.1.1 Keyboard (A)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 2.5.7 Dragging Movements (AA)
- 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (AA)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-stack">
  <label for="ex-range"
    >Volume
    <output class="nd-slider__value" id="ex-range-value" for="ex-range"
      >40</output
    ></label
  >
  <input
    class="nd-slider"
    id="ex-range"
    type="range"
    min="0"
    max="100"
    step="1"
    value="40"
    data-range-output="ex-range-value"
  />
  <label for="ex-range-stepped"
    >Rating
    <output
      class="nd-slider__value"
      id="ex-range-stepped-value"
      for="ex-range-stepped"
      >3</output
    ></label
  >
  <input
    class="nd-slider"
    id="ex-range-stepped"
    type="range"
    min="1"
    max="5"
    step="1"
    value="3"
    data-range-output="ex-range-stepped-value"
  />
  <label for="ex-range-disabled">Unavailable volume</label>
  <input
    class="nd-slider"
    id="ex-range-disabled"
    type="range"
    min="0"
    max="100"
    value="40"
    disabled
  />
</div>
```
